notes_list.title: Constitutional Status: L.M. Singhvi Committee
notes_list.basic_overview: The constitutional status for Panchayati Raj institutions was recommended by the L.M. Singhvi Committee (1986).
notes_list.extra_info_content: This led to the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act 1992, in force from 24 April 1993. Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) recommended the three-tier system; Ashok Mehta Committee (1977) recommended a two-tier system.
